Human resource management
Employee turnover and retention
at Al-Futtaim Group
Done by Reem Nihar Ahamed
What the words mean
Employee turnover
The number of employees who leave a company over a period of time.
Employee retention
The ability of a company to keep its employees and encourage them to stay.
(CIPD, 2025; CIPD, 2026; Griffeth, Hom and Gaertner, 2000)
Why it matters for Al-Futtaim
A well-known UAE group with many different businesses.
Automotive
Retail
Real estate
Financial services
Skilled and experienced people keep productivity high, customers happy and goals on track.
(Al-Futtaim, n.d.)
Problems of high turnover
Higher costs
More money goes on hiring and training new staff.
Lost experience
Valuable knowledge leaves, and new staff need time to learn.
Weaker teamwork
Teamwork and customer satisfaction can suffer.
(CIPD, 2025; Allen, Bryant and Vardaman, 2010)
How to keep staff
Fair pay and benefits
Pay that feels fair for the work done.
Training and growth
For example, new skills for electric vehicles.
Good managers
Recognise achievements, listen and build a positive workplace.
Listen and learn
Surveys and exit interviews show why people leave.
(Allen, Bryant and Vardaman, 2010; SHRM, 2025; IMI, n.d.)
Conclusion
Employees are an important part of a company’s success.
When a company invests in its employees, it also invests in its future.
Questions are welcome
You stayed until the end. That is excellent audience retention!
